title: "FindVariables"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-03"
---

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

```

```{r}
# 1. Get the safe path to the folder
data <- here("data")

# 2. List all files inside that folder
file_list <- list.files(path = data, pattern = "^AHS.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
inp_file_list <- list.files(path = data, pattern = "^inp.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

print(inp_file_list)

```

```{r}
# NHS survey
variable_catalogue <- data.frame()

for (file in unique(file_list)) {
  
  vars <- names(
    read_csv(
      file,
      n_max = 0, # Read column names
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  )
  
  temp <- data.frame( # temporary data frame for one file
    File = basename(file),
    Variable = vars
  )
  
  variable_catalogue <- bind_rows(
    variable_catalogue,
    temp
  )
}
```

```{r}
# inp survey
inp_variable_catalogue <- data.frame()

for (file in unique(inp_file_list)) {
  
  vars <- names(
    read_csv(
      file,
      n_max = 0, # Read column names
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  )
  
  temp <- data.frame( # temporary data frame for one file
    File = basename(file),
    Variable = vars
  )
  
  inp_variable_catalogue <- bind_rows(
    inp_variable_catalogue,
    temp
  )
}
```



```{r}
# Find the location of the variable
variable_catalogue %>%
  filter(Variable == "AGEB") # Or use regex: grepl("EXREG", Variable)
```

```{r}
inp_variable_catalogue %>%
  filter(Variable == "ALCTYPT") # Or use regex: grepl("EXREG", Variable)
```
